name: ZKSwap Ethereum bridge Exodus Mode incident
summary: Blockaid reports approximately USD 5 million withdrawn from an Ethereum bridge after emergency-exit proof checks accepted unsupported claims. Historical verifier deployment and claim-uniqueness behavior require independent source and transaction review.

primary_sources.summary: Security-researcher report describes emergency proof-verification and duplicate-claim weaknesses on the Ethereum Layer 1 bridge.

coverage_gaps: Full affected-contract and transaction identifiers were not established from accessible text in this pass; embedded screenshots are not independently verified evidence.
Recover incident-time bridge, verifier and proxy implementations. Distinguish annotated example code in reporting from exact deployed source.
Independently verify chain, Solidity language, incident timing, gross withdrawals, net loss and any recovery.
Source rights, earliest disclosure, family assignment and human adjudication remain unresolved; no eligibility or benchmark promotion is established.
